summary: This informational RFC describes the Russian Federal standard GOST R 34.12-2015 block cipher known as Kuznyechik, which has a 128-bit block length and a 256-bit key length. It is one of the Russian cryptographic standard algorithms.

eli5.summary: A block cipher scrambles messages in chunks using a secret key. Kuznyechik is a scrambling method from Russia, and this document explains how it works.
